findings.claim: The catch block awaits an unguarded prisma.workflowReminder.update to increment retryCount. That update can throw, for example P2025 when the row was deleted concurrently or by the earlier deleteMany. The error then escapes the for loop, which skips the remaining reminders and the original error log and aborts the cron run.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:189-199, the catch block awaits an unguarded prisma.workflowReminder.update (lines 190-197) before logging the original error at line 198. If that update throws (e.g., P2025 after a concurrent deletion or overlapping cron run's deleteMany, though not the same run's deleteMany at lines 29-45 which precedes findMany at line 48), the error skips line 198, escapes the for loop at lines 67-200, and aborts the cron handler via defaultHandler.

findings.claim: The deleteMany OR branch { retryCount: { gt: 1 } } has no method: WorkflowMethods.SMS filter (and no scheduled:false filter). The SMS cron therefore deletes EMAIL, WHATSAPP and already-scheduled WorkflowReminder rows with retryCount > 1.

verifier.reason: In packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:29-45, `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` is placed inside only the first `OR` branch (line 33), leaving the second branch `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` (lines 38-42) without a `method` or `scheduled: false` filter. As a result, `deleteMany` matches and deletes any `WorkflowReminder` row with `retryCount > 1` regardless of `method` (including `EMAIL` and `WHATSAPP`) or `scheduled` status.

findings.claim: The WhatsApp cron uses the same twilio.scheduleSMS path and has the same retry-forever problem, but it does not use retryCount even though the column exists on every WorkflowReminder.

verifier.reason: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleWhatsappReminders.ts:90-114 calls twilio.scheduleSMS and leaves scheduled=false without incrementing retryCount when scheduling throws or returns undefined, while its deleteMany (lines 23-30) and findMany (lines 33-42) never check or select retryCount. Although retryCount exists on every WorkflowReminder at packages/prisma/schema.prisma:1000, only scheduleSMSReminders.ts was updated to use it, leaving the pre-existing retry loop in scheduleWhatsappReminders.ts untouched.
